The fact that the best-match lag varies widely across instruments (3–14 days) and that best-match lags were discovered by exhaustive search suggests they are fitting noise to noise, not detecting structure. High distinct-value counts (171–210 distinct values across 120–258 readings) and zero exact repetition runs confirm readings are not discretized or periodic.
